verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity exposes a full REST API for creating verification sessions (curl example), programmatic access to results, webhooks for automated reactions, and a CLI, which supports scripted/automated integration typical of CI-style workflows. However, the core verification step inherently requires a human to submit a document/selfie, so full headless end-to-end automation isn't possible, and there's no explicit mention of test-mode/CI tooling or SDK examples for automated pipelines. Missing for 10: documented test-mode fixtures for CI, explicit CI/automation guidance, and independent confirmation of headless orchestration.
